sections.title: Partitioning & Consistent Hashing
sections.description:
Consistent Hashing Algorithm

Hashes keys and server nodes onto a 2^32 circular ring. When a server node is added or removed, only 1/N-th of the total keys need to be remapped, eliminating total cluster re-sharding overhead.
